scenicChapters.title: Basque Coast Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Basque Coast Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-collegiale-de-ziortza-cathedrale-.story: From Ermua it runs 102 km to Ermua; allow about 1 h 46 of riding. It goes by way of Santimamiñe, Cathédrale de Saint Jacques Apôtre and back through Santimamiñe. The line favours views over speed.

legend-german-fairy-tale-route.slogan: German Fairy Tale Route – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-german-fairy-tale-route.story: official tourism route. historic towns, forests, folklore. From Hanau am Main it runs 395 km to Bremen; allow about 7 h 11 of riding. It goes by way of Steinau an der Straße, Marburg an der Lahn, Kassel and Hameln. The line favours views over speed.
